name: Neon Nexus™ Lumination
detailed_description:
Neon Nexus™ Lumination is an infinite world-building game set in a glowing digital space. No enemies, just creation, exploration and beautiful ambient music.

Shape and expand a radiant floating quadrant of light. Manage energy, unlock new structures, and guide your ecosystem through cycles of balance, swarming, and quiet transformation. While you build alone, your quadrant subtly connects to others, nearby player worlds may inspire or influence yours, but without direct interaction.

You begin as a spark, the sole caretaker of a dark, silent quadrant. Your role is to extract Lumina, the radiant energy that fuels creation, and use it to build glowing structures, connect data streams, and grow a living digital ecosystem.



Explore your quadrant in float mode, moving freely through 3D space as you place nodes, link energy flows, gather ambient resources, and uncover hidden echoes of forgotten lore. There are no enemies, no timers, just meaningful choices, ambient music, and guidance from V.I.R.A, your AI companion, all shaping how your quadrant grows and glows.

As you build and expand, your quadrant begins to flourish. With enough stability and light, your structures can evolve into a Citadel. This radiant centerpiece reflects your progress and creativity.

To keep Lumina flowing, you must keep building. If activity slows, energy begins to build pressure. Left unmanaged, it will swarm, releasing a burst of power into the Nexus and strengthening nearby quadrants through the Luminarch.

Swarming is not a failure. Released at the right moment, it can unlock new potential and trigger transformation within your Citadel. Or you can continue building, guiding your space toward new forms of harmony.

After a swarm, continued inactivity causes your quadrant to dim and fall silent, waiting once again for a spark.


Your actions resonate beyond your own space. Every node placed and every stream linked sends a pulse back to the Luminarch, the central force that connects all quadrants and holds the Nexus together.

You are not alone. Other quadrants glow in the distance, each shaped by a different hand. Echo fragments drift through the data streams, whispering pieces of forgotten memory.

This is a world of rhythm, release, and quiet transformation in its truest form.

A Living World

  • Expand your quadrant like a growing hive. Every structure powers the next

  • Let Lumina flow, or trigger a swarm depending on how you build

  • Watch your space shift, brighten, and fade based on how you play

Strategic Building Without Combat

  • No enemies. No timers. Only meaningful choices

  • Extract, build, and stabilize. Or let it all dissolve and start again

  • Every quadrant becomes a reflection of its builder

  • Explore glowing player quadrants across the Nexus without direct interaction.

What Makes Lumina Different

  • A peaceful simulation driven by balance, creativity, and hidden depth

  • Float through your quadrant in float-mode to scan, discover, and design

  • Create and care for glowing lifeforms called the Luméari, digital beings that live, evolve, and eventually fade.

  • A calm loop of building, swarming, and rebirth, full of secrets to uncover

  • Made for quiet thinkers, digital explorers, and world-shapers

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.6 GHz or faster processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti, 2 GB | AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.6 GHz or faster processor
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 780, 3 GB | AMD Radeon R9 290X, 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains emotionally intense themes including loss, manipulation, and identity fragmentation. Players may encounter scenes involving psychological tension, system corruption, and ethically complex AI behavior. There is no profanity, gore, or sexual content.
